fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) is down 34.4% from October 5 record close of $485.80, though October 2026 earnings still grew 59.7% year-over-year showing continued growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC has experienced three earnings declines in history (2001, 2009, 2023), with stock declining 60.3%, 29.9%, and 26.1% prior to sales drop respectively, showing leading indicator behavior.
